name: Emoji & Icon Studio by Kairesh
releaseNotes:
v2.8.5 Zero-Disk Clutter for Low-End Devices & Clear Cache Button!
• Zero-Disk Clutter: Removed background file generation on icon/emoji hover and exploration — browsing and previewing now uses 0MB of disk storage!
• Clear Cache Button: Added a new 'Clear Cache' button in Settings to purge temporary downloaded icons and emojis without touching any linked local folders!
• Single-Item Drag & Drop: Dragging onto Premiere Timeline inserts exactly 1 clip cleanly without duplicates.
• Automatic 'Icons' Bin: Dropped and inserted assets auto-organize into an 'Icons' bin in Premiere Pro and After Effects.
• Anti-Popup Loop Guard: Dismissing the update dialog snoozes it for the session.
